title: 'All Thumbs' (3/3)
summaryZh: 以凱西老是把東西弄掉為例，說明「笨手笨腳」這個說法的用法。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Words and Their Stories

sentences.text: She'll end up dropping everything, and then we won't have drinks at the party.
sentences.zh: 她最後一定會把東西全打翻，那派對上就沒飲料喝了。

sentences.text: Actually, at the last party, she dropped the cake.
sentences.zh: 其實上次派對的時候，她就把蛋糕摔了。

sentences.text: On second thought, I'll have her bring the ice.
sentences.zh: 我再想想，還是叫她負責帶冰塊好了。

sentences.text: If she drops the bags of ice, it'll only help break it up.
sentences.zh: 就算她把整袋冰塊摔了，也只會幫忙把冰敲碎而已。

sentences.text: And that's all the time we have for this Words and Their Stories.
sentences.zh: 本集《Words and Their Stories》的時間就到這裡了。

sentences.text: Until next time, I'm Ana Mateo.
